column1: Project L is a collection of optimal combos on every character from 0% up to where dthrow upB starts to kill, something I like to call "Grab to Death". A lot of players only know what to do off of a grab at 0 and 70+%, Completely missing out on easy kill confirms in the low to mid % range. Luigi has a true kill confirm at any % on any character, and this document provides you with all of them. This project has been an on and off effort for almost two years now, and I started working on it on March 8th, 2020 (Completed 7/4/2022). To get started, you can hover over which character you would like to look at above and click on the link that pops up and it'll take you to the sheet. You could also just scroll through the sheets down at the bottom, which if you are on mobile is probably the best option. Also, I am willing to bet I made a few mistakes here and there, so just shoot me a message on twitter or discord if you find anything that I need to fix. Read the note on this box for more information.
